label: 交叠腿坐姿 + 举臂
pose_lead: Grounded pose, seated with crossed legs and one arm raised:
lower_limbs: The legs cross and fold in front of the body, one leg passing in front of the other.
upper_limbs: One hand props on the ground behind and to the side while the other arm lifts, bends, and brings the hand behind the head.
torso_head: The chest rises with a slight side-bend through the waist; the head faces forward.
weight_silhouette: The arms sit at two different heights for a clear asymmetry; the overall line feels stretched and open.
